No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this workshop you understand how experimental methods test interpretations with safe materials.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Question and hypothesis orientation
  • Instructor replica demonstration
  • Document observed variables
  • Interpret limits and write a note

How the time is spent

  1. Question and hypothesis orientation 25 min

  2. Instructor replica demonstration 50 min

  3. Document observed variables 65 min

  4. Interpret limits and write a note 40 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Frame a question and hypothesis that an experiment could test.
  • Document the variables observed during an instructor's safe replica demonstration.
  • Interpret the limits of what the demonstration shows and write a short note.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
